qa_pairs.question: What is the key difference between a standard CPU task page and a CPU job array page?
qa_pairs.answer: The page for a CPU task within a job array is identical to a regular CPU task page, except for the addition of an "Other jobs in the array" section. This section provides a list of other task numbers belonging to the same job array, along with their status, name, start time, and end time.

qa_pairs.question: What details are presented at the top of a GPU task page, and how can users access submission-related information?
qa_pairs.answer: At the top of a GPU task page, users will see the task's name, its assigned number, their username, and the current status. Details of the submission script can be viewed by clicking on "Voir le script de la tâche," unless the task was launched interactively, in which case the script will not be available. The working directory and submission command can be accessed by clicking "Voir la commande de soumission."
